title: RACK MOUNTED ENTERPRISE SERVER

onscreen_lines.desc: CWEP is requesting proposals for a rack-mounted enterprise server to serve as a virtualization host in our production environment. The proposed hardware must be fully compatible with Proxmox Virtual Environment (PVE), including support for Linux-based hardware drivers and standard virtualization technologies. The system should meet or exceed the below required minimum specifications with exact or equivalent hardware. Vendors must provide: Complete hardware specifications, Warranty and support terms, Estimated lead time, and Total delivered cost with submitted proposals. Minimum Specifications: 2x 32-core/64-thread AMD 9335 CPUs 16x 64G ECC RDIMM, 1 TB total 1x 960G M.2 SSD 6x 7.68 TB NVMe SSDs in drive bays 1x 4-SFP+ AIOM NIC 2x 2-SFP+ PCIe NICs TPM 2.0 2x 2kW PSUs 2x cable management arms ** PLEASE UPLOAD PROPOSALS, SPECIFICATIONS, AND ALL CORRESPONDING DOCUMENTS TO THE "RESPONSE ATTACHMENTS" TAB.
